environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL resource-based policy grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/MigrationOrchestrator with condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID=o-abc123def4. Unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service frontend before reaching handler code. The function is additionally deployed behind a VPC endpoint policy that restricts invoke actions to the same principal. Note: the SQL injection vulnerability in schema_prefix and tenant_id parameters remains in the code - the control is purely at the invocation authentication layer.

config.unsigned_request_behavior: 403 Forbidden returned by Lambda service before function invocation
